title: chore: allow community model publishers
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `meow18838` (GitHub ID `162339795`) to the community-model publisher allowlist.
- Adds `Lorodn4x` (GitHub ID `130518306`) from #12789.
- Changes only the immutable GitHub ID allowlist.

Checks:
- `biome check shared/auth/github-id-list.ts`
- `git diff --check`

Fixes #12789

gist.headline: Two more garden tenders
gist.blurb: The community model garden has two new people with the keys. More builders can now publish models for the rest of the hive to explore.
gist.summary: Added immutable GitHub ID allowlist entries for meow18838 (162339795) and Lorodn4x (130518306), enabling both contributors to publish community models.
gist.impact: Community model publishers meow18838 and Lorodn4x can now add models to the shared Pollinations ecosystem.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli warmly welcoming two new community gardeners at a cozy code-garden gate, each carrying a small glowing model seed packet with a GitHub-style ID tag. Show model-plants sprouting from pots beside a retro terminal to represent new contributors gaining publisher access.
